sources.note: Netsmart main site. Company overview: 500K+ users, 24K+ orgs, CareFabric platform with 8 certified products. Markets: behavioral health, post-acute care, human services.

ONC mandatory disclosures page listing all 8 certified products: myAvatar, myEvolv, myUnity, myUnity Senior Living, GEHRIMED, TheraOffice, myHealthPointe, CarePathways. Each has EHI All Data Export links and Real World Testing docs.

GEHRIMED product page. Describes it as cloud-based EHR and practice management for LTPAC/PALTC practitioners. Key features: Census Manager, wound assessment, e-prescribing, billing/RCM, MIPS dashboard, PointClickCare integration, AlphaCollector.
GEHRIMED mobile EHR platform marketing page. Emphasizes multi-facility rounding workflow, mobile-first design, and practice growth capabilities.
Press release about GEHRIMED's ONC Health IT 2015 Cures Update certification (Dec 2022). Notes GEHRIMED was first LTPAC EHR to receive ONC certification in 2011.
2025 blog post on upcoming GEHRIMED features: redesigned dashboard, facility-agnostic integrations, new mobile app, AI ambient listening, automated annotation from photo capture.
Blog on GEHRIMED interoperability: Carequality integration, CareConnect network, PointClickCare bi-directional integration, myHealthPointe patient portal.
2025 Black Book Research Survey: GEHRIMED ranked #1 in Geriatrics and Gerontology EHR & Practice Management. 749 gerontology practices surveyed across 58 competing solutions.
GEHRIMED review aggregation: 4.3/5 overall (25 reviews, 88% positive). Lists specialties served and feature descriptions. User reviews cite documentation efficiency and quality measure tracking.
EHR In Practice profile for GEHRIMED. Confirms target market as LTPAC practitioners, lists supported specialties including Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Behavioral Health, Nephrology.
GEHRIMED macOS App Store listing. Confirms desktop and iPad app availability for mobile use at bedside.
GI Partners portfolio page for Netsmart. Confirms ownership structure, $950M acquisition in 2016, TA Associates joining in 2018.
2024 Yahoo Finance article on Netsmart owners exploring sale at $5B+ valuation including debt.
Tracxn acquisitions tracker for Netsmart. Lists 17+ acquisitions including GPM/GEHRIMED (2021), TheraOffice (2022), Netalytics (2023), Change Healthcare Home Care (2023), HealthPivots (2024).
